# Measurements and moving rooms

New-room width/depth fields, including custom drawings, measure between the inside wall faces, before baseboard projection. With 12 cm walls, a requested 5 × 4 m room stores a 5.12 × 4.12 m wall-reference outline. Adding beside an existing thicker shared wall solves against that actual thickness after joining. Width/depth for nonrectangular templates are the joined inside outline's bounding spans; the shape stays nonrectangular.

Existing version 1 polygons remain wall reference lines. Loading, recovery and Undo never inflate outlines or move furniture. A saved 5 m reference span with two 12 cm walls correctly reads 4.88 m inside. Saved/drafted vertices and floor-plan guides remain reference lines. New single-room drawings are scaled to the typed inside dimensions before their first save. Unclosed floor-plan edge labels follow reference lines; closed draft sizes and editor dimensions show the inside measure separately. If wall thickness collapses a legacy interior, the dimensions inspector preserves the project and offers explicitly labelled reference-size repair.

Door chains use the same inside-face endpoints and normal offset for their geometry and numbers. Placement and rendering share pure physical wall pieces, trim intervals, affine trim miters and door-panel poses. Trim clearance includes actual vertical height and only extends intervals at true wall ends; square doorway/jamb ends remain open. Exact saved model bounds remain conservative collision shapes. Existing colliding saved placements still decode unchanged and can be moved out.

Build → Move room previews a rigid translation. Rooms connected by shared walls form one group, so both faces of an opening remain joined. Unlocked furniture, openings, per-face finishes and trim follow the group; detached rooms stay fixed. Any locked furniture in the group blocks the move and is selected for review/unlocking. A lock in a detached room does not block it. The signed X/Z fields are offsets from the saved position, using Settings units. One-finger dragging inside the group previews its offset; outside dragging/pinching navigates. The original outline stays dashed during preview.

Cancel never changes project/history. Apply validates overlap, wall joins, opening references and furniture clearance before recording one command. A rejected move retains the exact history. Undo/Redo and durable reload preserve the room/furniture relationship. Walk and house overview permit no room editing. Presentation-only floor separation never changes canonical room or furniture coordinates.

Evidence is recorded in STATUS.md, boundary-adoption/, spatial-measurements-ui.json and the current frozen/native export reports. Browser/CPU/export checks remain distinct from physical phone execution; do not treat an in-progress or earlier report as current acceptance.
